title: Visiting a place you’ve dreamed of in real life
content: Has this ever happened to you?: You dreamed in a certain location, then later went to that location in real life without knowing it actually existed? When I was in middle school, I dreamed I was in a very unique looking shop that had a large round fountain in it. Not too long after that, I took a trip to Sedona, Arizona with my family. I was no more than 13 at the time. We were walking down a street checking out some stores and whatnot, and I walked into a shop that looked EXACTLY like the place I had dreamed of. It was uncanny. I had never been to Arizona before this and did not know anything about Sedona, plus I lived nowhere near AZ. There’s no way I could have known about this place before going there. I’m in my late 20s now and still occasionally think about this.
